findings.description: The empirical Stata and simulation MATLAB pipelines could not be executed because the required interpreters are absent. This report does not establish whether any reported output recurs.
findings.evidence: Runtime check in logs/runtime_check.txt found no Stata, MATLAB, or Octave executable. The R script was only an environment check.
findings.suggested_fix: Run a command-by-command direct translation of the full Stata and MATLAB workflows in a supported R environment, preserving the shipped analysis and inputs, then report each printed result separately.

findings.evidence: Claims C14 and C15 aggregate multiple printed numbers; result records for those exhibits are not one-per-number.
findings.suggested_fix: Expand the claim and result inventory to one result per printed data-derived number after the pipeline can be translated and run.

limitations: The user required translation of the full shipped Stata pipeline and specified that reported data-derived numbers must be checked individually. That translation was not completed; this is a partial benchmark record, not a completed reproduction study.
The package includes MATLAB model code and custom solver dependencies, including compiled or platform-specific components. No MATLAB or Octave runtime was installed.
